## Receipt

**status:** completed  
**commit:** `a8a2b5bedc215d692ad1ac41d7ad9b5622e11a94`  
**title:** `fix(package): isolate test prepack materializations`  
**parent:** `9670e2b9d388b15f24000ec252f6d8e55dd0551f` (strict forward descendant; single new commit; no amend)

### Root cause
Package-lifecycle tests ran `npm pack`/`prepack`/`tsc` against shared `packageRoot`, so default-concurrency importers could observe a cross-file partial `dist` tree.

### Repair
- Deepened `test/helpers/pi-test-harness.ts` with `trackedPackageInputPaths`, `materializePackageTree`, and `packIsolatedPackage` (real prepack chain in a private materialization; excludes only generated native binding from tracked ownership; provisions offline `node_modules`).
- Replaced `npmPackTo` in `test/helpers/recorder-test-harness.ts` to call that seam (no second packing path).
- Routed Collector, Reviewer, and Recorder inventory/install packs through isolated packing; Recorder clean-checkout Git-clean install/build/repeated-pack remains on its isolated checkout.
- Added concurrent pack + shared-dist contract-import stress oracle in `test/pi-test-harness.test.ts` (snapshot excludes host-local `rename_no_replace.node`, which concurrent native-build lifecycle tests legitimately republish).

### Scope honored
Test harnesses + package-lifecycle tests only. No production scripts/Souls/schema/AC, no suite serialization, no weakened inventory/install/bin/native assertions.

### Verification
| Gate | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Focused harness + collector/recorder/reviewer lifecycle | pass |
| `HOME=<hermetic> npm test` run 1 (default concurrency) | **325/325 pass** |
| `HOME=<hermetic> npm test` run 2 (default concurrency) | **325/325 pass** |
| `npm run typecheck` | clean |
| Final isolated `packIsolatedPackage` | 63 files; required inventory present (bin, contracts, recorder native binding, scripts, souls/src) |
| Shared tracked `dist` (excl. generated binding) after final pack | unchanged |
| `git status` after commit | clean |

### Findings disposition
- Planned isolation path adopted as specified.
- Stress-oracle snapshot deliberately omits generated native binding so it does not false-fail against the existing concurrent native-build lifecycle test; prepack race class (TS multi-file emission) remains covered via package-contracts/recorder JS identity + live `terminating-tools`/`judge-output` imports.
